evidence.quote: PT five days this week, 45 to 60 minutes per session, plus OT five days
enoxaparin 40 subcutaneous daily through day 28
transfers improved from moderate assist of two to minimal assist of one
Ambulation 40 feet to 110 feet with with the rolling walker and contact guard
ambulation 110 to 200 feet with the rolling walker and supervision
Ambulation 300 feet with the rolling walker, independent
Home health could not provide twice daily transfer assistance and daily injections for someone living alone

sentences.text: He came to the skilled unit after a 4 day inpatient hospital stay for surgical repair of a left femoral neck fracture.
sentences.quote: after a 4 day inpatient stay for a left femoral neck fracture treated with cephalomedullary nail fixation

sentences.text: During the denied period he received PT five days in the week plus OT five days, with sessions lasting 45 to 60 minutes.
sentences.quote: PT five days this week, 45 to 60 minutes per session, plus OT five days

sentences.text: He also required daily skilled nursing for enoxaparin injections through day 28 with ongoing incision monitoring and pain titration.
sentences.quote: enoxaparin 40 subcutaneous daily through day 28

sentences.text: His transfers improved from needing moderate help from two people to needing minimal help from one person.
sentences.quote: transfers improved from moderate assist of two to minimal assist of one

sentences.text: His walking with a rolling walker progressed from 40 feet to 110 feet with standby help for safety.
sentences.quote: Ambulation 40 feet to 110 feet with with the rolling walker and contact guard

sentences.text: The next week his walking advanced further from 110 to 200 feet with supervision.
sentences.quote: ambulation 110 to 200 feet with the rolling walker and supervision

sentences.text: By the end of the stay he walked 300 feet independently with the walker.
sentences.quote: Ambulation 300 feet with the rolling walker, independent

sentences.text: He progressed to climbing 14 steps with a rail and supervision, meeting the goal needed to reach his apartment.
sentences.quote: Stairs 14 steps with one rail and supervision

sentences.text: The physician documented that he could not yet manage the stairs home and needed help for every transfer.
sentences.quote: Cannot yet manage the 14 stairs to the apartment

sentences.text: The physician explained that home health could not provide the twice daily transfer help and daily injections he needed while living alone, so the inpatient stay had to continue.
sentences.quote: Home health could not provide twice daily transfer assistance and daily injections for someone living alone
